name: Monday.com
description: Monday.com is a visual work-management platform built around customizable boards, dashboards, and automations.
best_for: Vendor targets enterprise-scale organizations wanting to scale projects and operations through combined human and AI-agent workflows.
features: Gantt and timeline views for scheduling
Forms for intake and Docs for collaborative documentation
AI agents for research, reporting, and scheduling

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 2 seats, 3 boards, unlimited docs, and 200+ templates.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $9/seat/mo ($27/mo min for 3 seats); adds unlimited items, 5GB storage, and prioritized support.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $12/seat/mo ($36/mo min); adds Timeline/Gantt views, Calendar view, guest access, and 250 automations/mo.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $19/seat/mo ($57/mo min); adds private boards, formula columns, time tracking, and 25,000 automations/mo.

pros: Intuitive color-coded visual boards with flexible column custom fields and cross-board dashboard widgets
Rich no-code automation engine connecting status triggers, email alerts, and external app integrations
Built-in intake request forms and shareable client guest views for seamless project coordination
cons: Strict 3-seat minimum requirement on all paid plans increases entry cost for solo practitioners and 2-person teams
Time tracking, formula columns, and dependency logic require upgrading to the Pro plan ($19/seat/month)
Can feel overly complex for simple task tracking compared to lightweight checklist apps

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A work-management platform focused on projects, tasks, timelines, and team coordination.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a more structured, list-first workflow

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: A project-management platform with tasks, dashboards, documents, and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want more customization and an all-in-one workspace

alternatives.name: Trello
alternatives.description: A simple visual project-management tool based on boards, lists, and cards.
alternatives.best_for: Small teams that want the simplest possible board view

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, or organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool bundled with invoicing and billing
